No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you get the game tickets?
dialogue.zh: 你買到球賽門票了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I got two good seats.
dialogue.zh: 有啊，買到兩個好座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the seats?
dialogue.zh: 座位在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the north stand.
dialogue.zh: 在北看台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that close to the field?
dialogue.zh: 那個位置離球場近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row six is pretty close.
dialogue.zh: 第六排還挺近的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much were the tickets?
dialogue.zh: 門票多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty dollars for each one.
dialogue.zh: 一張五十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is not cheap at all.
dialogue.zh: 那一點都不便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But live games are worth it.
dialogue.zh: 但現場看球很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it hard to get them?
dialogue.zh: 票搶得很難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So hard, they sold out in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɑrd, ðeɪ soʊld aʊt ɪn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 超難，幾分鐘就賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how do we have two?
dialogue.zh: 那我們怎麼還有兩張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fan sold me his own pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fæn soʊld mi hɪz oʊn pɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有個球迷把他那兩張賣給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pick better seats next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi pɪk ˈbɛtər sits nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次我們可以選更好的位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let us check online again.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我們再上網看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the stadium from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz ðə ˈstædiəm frʌm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 球場離這裡多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about twenty minutes away.
dialogue.zh: 大約二十分鐘的車程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we driving or taking the train?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈdraɪvɪŋ ər ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə treɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要開車還是搭地鐵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The train is easier on game day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn ɪz ˈizɪər ɑn ɡeɪm deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 比賽日坐地鐵比較方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line goes to the stadium?
dialogue.zh: 哪條線可以到球場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the red line to Station Nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə rɛd laɪn tu ˈsteɪʃən naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 坐紅線到九號站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to change trains?
dialogue.zh: 我們需要換車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is one direct ride.
dialogue.zh: 不用，一票直達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, Saturday at three, right?
dialogue.zh: 所以是週六三點，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, it starts at three.
dialogue.zh: 對，三點開賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking near the stadium costs a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ nɪr ðə ˈstædiəm kɔsts ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 球場附近停車很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can park at the mall instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn pɑrk ʌt ðə mɔl ˌɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以改停在商場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shuttle from the mall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈʃʌtəl frʌm ðə mɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 商場有接駁車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only every fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 有，但十五分鐘才一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, the train beats waiting there.
dialogue.zh: 不過與其站著等它，搭地鐵快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the subway is our best plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈsʌbˌweɪ ɪz ˈaʊər bɛst plæn./
dialogue.zh: 所以搭地鐵是我們最好的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can our daughter come with us?
dialogue.zh: 女兒可以跟我們一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she wants to go too.
dialogue.zh: 可以，她也想去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do children need their own ticket?
dialogue.zh: 小孩也要自己的票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if they are over three.
dialogue.zh: 超過三歲才需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our daughter is just two years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈdɔtər ɪz dʒʌst tu jɪrz oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 我們女兒才兩歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she sits on your lap free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi sɪts ɑn jʊr læp fri./
dialogue.zh: 那她坐在大人腿上免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stadiums ban big bags, you know.
dialogue.zh: 球場禁止帶大包進場喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring a small backpack only.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ə smɔl ˈbækˌpæk ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 我只帶一個小後背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else are we not allowed to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɛls ɑr wi nɑt əˈlaʊd tu brɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼不能帶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No outside food or drinks at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd fud ər drɪŋks ʌt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 外帶的食物飲料一律不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a bottle of water?
dialogue.zh: 那一瓶水可以帶進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only sealed bottles are okay inside.
dialogue.zh: 只有未開封的可以帶進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cameras with big lenses either.
dialogue.zh: 大鏡頭的相機也不能帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone camera is good enough.
dialogue.zh: 我手機的鏡頭就夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the bag rules online.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tʃɛk ðə bæɡ rulz ˈɔnˌlaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們上網查一下包包的規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I will read them now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, aɪ wɪl rid ðɛm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我這就來看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should we meet outside?
dialogue.zh: 我們幾點在外面碰面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How about two at the east gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt tu ʌt ðə ist ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 兩點在東門口見怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That gives us an hour before kickoff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡɪvz ʌs ər ˈaʊr bɪˈfɔr ˈkɪkˌɔf./
dialogue.zh: 這樣開賽前還有一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, no mad dash for once.
dialogue.zh: 真好，這回不用一路狂奔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which gate is closer to our seats?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ɡeɪt ɪz ˈkloʊsər tu ˈaʊər sits?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個門口離我們的座位近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The east gate, gate number four.
dialogue.zh: 東門，四號入口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will send you the meeting spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛnd ju ðə ˈmitɪŋ spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我會把見面地點傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send a map link, please.
dialogue.zh: 記得傳地圖連結給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy flags for the team?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi baɪ flæɡz fər ðə tim?/
dialogue.zh: 要不要買加油旗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sell them at the gate stands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ sɛl ðɛm ʌt ðə ɡeɪt stændz./
dialogue.zh: 門口攤販就有賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope we can see the warmup.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp wi kæn si ðə ˈwɔrmˌʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我希望看得到熱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Players warm up an hour early.
dialogue.zh: 球員會提前一小時熱身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this our first big game together?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈaʊər fɜrst bɪɡ ɡeɪm təˈɡɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們第一次一起看大賽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I have never been to one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ hæv ˈnɛvər bɪn tu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 對，我從沒去過現場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will love the crowd energy.
dialogue.zh: 你會愛上現場的氣氛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already feel so excited.
dialogue.zh: 我已經興奮不行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looks like rain this Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 這週六看起來會下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain jackets, then, light ones.
dialogue.zh: 那就帶薄一點的雨衣吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are umbrellas allowed in the stands?
dialogue.zh: 看台上可以使用雨傘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they ban big umbrellas too.
dialogue.zh: 不行，大雨傘也被禁止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wear our team colors.
dialogue.zh: 我要穿我們隊的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, I have my old jersey too.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, aɪ hæv maɪ oʊld ˈdʒɜrzi tu./
dialogue.zh: 好耶，我也有我的舊球衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which team are you cheering for?
dialogue.zh: 你幫哪一隊加油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I support the home team always.
dialogue.zh: 我永遠挺主隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their star player is back from injury.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr stɑr ˈpleɪər ɪz bæk frʌm ˈɪndʒəri./
dialogue.zh: 他們的明星球員傷癒復出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So this one is a big deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs wʌn ɪz ə bɪɡ dil./
dialogue.zh: 所以這場分外重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you eat yet? It is a long afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju it jɛt? ɪt ɪz ə lɔŋ ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 你吃過了嗎？下午很長的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us grab a quick bite first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡræb ə kwɪk baɪt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我們先隨便吃一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food inside the stadium is pricey.
dialogue.zh: 場內的餐飲很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can eat near the station.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在車站附近吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have your tickets on your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv jʊr ˈtɪkɪts ɑn jʊr foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你的票存在手機裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I saved the QR codes.
dialogue.zh: 有，我存好了QR碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my phone dies inside?
dialogue.zh: 萬一手機在場內沒電怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a spare charger in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə spɛr ˈtʃɑrdʒər ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我包裡有一個備用充電器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery is at ten percent now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbætəri ɪz ʌt tɛn pərˈsɛnt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我手機現在只剩百分之十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge it before we leave home.
dialogue.zh: 那出門前先充飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the seats covered if it rains?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə sits ˈkʌvərd ɪf ɪt reɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 下雨的話座位有遮雨棚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The upper rows stay dry there.
dialogue.zh: 上面幾排淋不太到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seats are under the roof edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər sits ɑr ˈʌndər ðə ruf ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位正好在屋檐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we will stay dry then.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我們就不會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we resell tickets if we cannot go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ˌrisɛl ˈtɪkɪts ɪf wi ˈkænɑt ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 去不了的話可以轉賣門票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app allows it till Friday noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp əˈlaʊz ɪt tɪl ˈfraɪˌdeɪ nun./
dialogue.zh: 應用程式到週五中午前都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we are definitely going.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們這一趟去定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will be a great day out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl bi ə ɡreɪt deɪ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 這一天一定會很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set my alarm for nine.
dialogue.zh: 我設了九點的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why so early on a Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 週六幹麼這麼早？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can drop bags at my place first.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn drɑp bæɡz ʌt maɪ pleɪs fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 可以先去我家放包包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saves time, see you then.
dialogue.zh: 那樣省時間，到時見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me a message in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 早上傳則訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, sleep well tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我會的，今晚好眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big game tomorrow, I cannot sleep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ɡeɪm təˈmɑroʊ, aɪ ˈkænɑt slip ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 明天有大賽，我已經睡不著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try to rest, it is a long day.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ tu rɛst, ɪt ɪz ə lɔŋ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 快點休息，明天還有一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, this security line is so long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ, ðɪs sɪˈkjʊrəti laɪn ɪz soʊ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 唉，安檢隊伍排得好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still have thirty minutes to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɪl hæv ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts tu spɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們還剩三十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, put your bag on the belt.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst, pʊt jʊr bæɡ ɑn ðə bɛlt./
dialogue.zh: 接著把包包放上傳輸帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I take out my phone too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk aʊt maɪ foʊn tu?/
dialogue.zh: 手機也要拿出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your hands out of your pockets.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jʊr hænz aʊt əv jʊr ˈpɑkɪts./
dialogue.zh: 兩手不要插在口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I am ready to walk through.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ æm ˈrɛdi tu wɔk θru./
dialogue.zh: 好，我準備走安檢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the guard just waved us through.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə ɡɑrd dʒʌst weɪvd ʌs θru./
dialogue.zh: 結果保全揮揮手就讓我們過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? No problems with small bags.
dialogue.zh: 看吧？小包沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we need concourse level three.
dialogue.zh: 現在要去三樓大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signs point up those escalators.
dialogue.zh: 指示牌指向那些電扶梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Section two twelve, where is it?
dialogue.zh: 二一二區，在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn left after the team store.
dialogue.zh: 經過球隊商店就往左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our row is F, the sixth row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər roʊ ɪz ɛf, ðə sɪksθ roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們是F排，第六排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rows are marked with white letters.
dialogue.zh: 排號都用白色字母標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seats are numbered one to twenty here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sits ɑr ˈnʌmbərd wʌn tu ˈtwɛnti hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡座位是一到二十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours are fourteen and fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位是十四和十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this your seat?
dialogue.zh: 借過一下，這是你的位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your seats are behind mine.
dialogue.zh: 不是，你們的位子在我後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the seats from the aisle.
dialogue.zh: 從走道那邊開始數座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven, eight, nine, here we are.
dialogue.zh: 七、八、九，到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These seats have a perfect view.
dialogue.zh: 這些座位視野超好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see the whole field.
dialogue.zh: 我能看到整個球場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here they come, out on the grass!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðeɪ kʌm, aʊt ɑn ðə ɡræs!/
dialogue.zh: 球員出來了，踏上草坪了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crowd roars for them.
dialogue.zh: 全場為他們歡吼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am hungry, let us get food.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈhʌŋɡri, lɛt ʌs ɡɛt fud./
dialogue.zh: 我餓了，我們去買吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do they sell at the stands?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ðeɪ sɛl ʌt ðə stændz?/
dialogue.zh: 場內攤販都賣些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot dogs, nachos, and popcorn.
dialogue.zh: 熱狗、起司脆片和爆米花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get me a large popcorn with butter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt mi ə lɑrdʒ ˈpɑpˌkɔrn wɪð ˈbʌtər./
dialogue.zh: 幫我買大份奶油爆米花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want anything to drink?
dialogue.zh: 你想喝點什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cold beer, please.
dialogue.zh: 請幫我買杯冰啤酒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one hot dog and a soda.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn hɑt dɔɡ ænd ə ˈsoʊdə./
dialogue.zh: 再加一份熱狗和一杯可樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add some mustard on the dog.
dialogue.zh: 熱狗上多加點芥末醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That will be twenty-two dollars.
dialogue.zh: 總共二十二美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I pay through the app?
dialogue.zh: 我可以用應用程式付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, just scan the little code.
dialogue.zh: 可以，掃一下那個小小的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, was that too easy?
dialogue.zh: 扣款成功，也太方便了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that bathroom line is huge.
dialogue.zh: 哇，洗手間那隊排超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us go before the match starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ bɪˈfɔr ðə mætʃ stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 開賽前我們先去好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the restrooms on this level?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɑr ðə ˈrɛstˌrumz ɑn ðɪs ˈlɛvəl?/
dialogue.zh: 這一層的洗手間在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right past the drink stand there.
dialogue.zh: 就在那個飲料攤後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a team scarf badly.
dialogue.zh: 我好想買一條球隊圍巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store is near our section.
dialogue.zh: 紀念品店就在我們區附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They can print your name on a jersey.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kæn prɪnt jʊr neɪm ɑn ə ˈdʒɜrzi./
dialogue.zh: 他們可以在球衣上印名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long does printing take?
dialogue.zh: 印字要花多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes, maybe less.
dialogue.zh: 大約二十分鐘，也許更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, put number ten on the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, pʊt ˈnʌmbər tɛn ɑn ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，背後幫我印十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your favorite player's number?
dialogue.zh: 那是你最愛球員的背號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is the team captain.
dialogue.zh: 對，他是隊長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they print letters in blue?
dialogue.zh: 他們可以用藍色印字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue matches our team colors well.
dialogue.zh: 藍色很配我們的隊色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try this jersey on for size.
dialogue.zh: 先試穿這件球衣看尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The medium fits me perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 中號穿起來剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take a photo here?
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡拍張照吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pose by the team logo.
dialogue.zh: 好，在隊徽旁邊擺姿勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand in front of the big sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ɪn frʌnt əv ðə bɪɡ saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 站到那個大招牌前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smile, I got three good shots.
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，我拍到三張好照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take one with your new jersey.
dialogue.zh: 穿上你的新球衣再拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will show off the ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, aɪ wɪl ʃoʊ ɔf ðə tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，我來秀一下那個十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seats look tiny from far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər sits lʊk ˈtaɪni frʌm fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位從遠處看小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But up close they are comfy.
dialogue.zh: 不過實際坐起來很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the mascot is dancing!
dialogue.zh: 看，吉祥物在跳舞！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids love him so much.
dialogue.zh: 小朋友們超愛他的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we take a picture with the mascot?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi teɪk ə ˈpɪktʃər wɪð ðə ˈmæskɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以跟吉祥物合照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a line, but it moves fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə laɪn, bʌt ɪt muvz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 有隊伍，但動得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun came out, no rain after all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn keɪm aʊt, noʊ reɪn ˈæftər ˌɔl./
dialogue.zh: 太陽出來了，根本沒下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I forgot my sunglasses at home.
dialogue.zh: 我墨鏡忘在家裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sell caps right over there.
dialogue.zh: 那邊就在賣球帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cheap cap beats a sunburn.
dialogue.zh: 有帽子總比曬傷好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can smell the fresh cut grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn smɛl ðə frɛʃ kʌt ɡræs./
dialogue.zh: 你聞得到剛剪過的草皮味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing beats this at home, right?
dialogue.zh: 在家看電視比不上，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the starting lineup on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ˈstɑrtɪŋ ˈlaɪnˌʌp ɑn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 先發名單上大螢幕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our captain leads the team out.
dialogue.zh: 我們的隊長率隊出場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everybody stands for the anthem now.
dialogue.zh: 現在全場起立聽國歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives me chills every single time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡivz mi tʃɪlz ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 每次都讓我起雞皮疙瘩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that drone over the field for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt droʊn ˈoʊvər ðə fild fər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 那台空拍機是在拍我們這區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they film us from above.
dialogue.zh: 對，他們從空中拍下全場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are tired from just standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ˈtaɪərd frʌm dʒʌst ˈstændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 光是站著我就腿痠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit now, kickoff comes soon.
dialogue.zh: 快坐，開球馬上就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear those drums?
dialogue.zh: 你有聽到那些鼓聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fans sing along to the drums.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fænz sɪŋ əˈlɔŋ tu ðə drʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 球迷跟著鼓聲一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That song is so catchy.
dialogue.zh: 那首歌好洗腦喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned it in five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我五分鐘就學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teach me the words to the chorus.
dialogue.phonetic: /titʃ mi ðə wɜrdz tu ðə ˈkɔrəs./
dialogue.zh: 教我唱副歌的歌詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just clap and sing along.
dialogue.zh: 跟著拍手一起唱就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the referee checks his watch.
dialogue.zh: 看，裁判在低頭看手錶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes to kickoff, everyone ready?
dialogue.zh: 開賽前兩分鐘，都準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Popcorn everywhere, this gets messy.
dialogue.zh: 爆米花落得滿處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the bag on your lap.
dialogue.zh: 把袋子放在腿上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My soda cup has a leak.
dialogue.zh: 我的可樂杯在漏耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, grab some napkins.
dialogue.zh: 噢不，快拿點紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, refills here are free.
dialogue.zh: 好消息，這裡續杯是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will get another one.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我再去接一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buy me a program booklet too.
dialogue.zh: 也幫我買一本節目手冊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists all the player numbers.
dialogue.zh: 裡面列了所有球員的背號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our friends saved seats nearby!
dialogue.zh: 看，我們的朋友留了位子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us walk over before kickoff.
dialogue.zh: 開球前先過去打個招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long time no see, guys!
dialogue.zh: 好久不見了，你們！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So glad we all made it.
dialogue.zh: 好高興我們都到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save the cheers, the match starts now.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə tʃɪrz, ðə mætʃ stɑrts naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 歡呼先留著，比賽現在開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shh, here we go, let us win!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑ, hɪr wi ɡoʊ, lɛt ʌs wɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 噓，開踢了，我們要贏！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team kicks off first.
dialogue.zh: 我們隊先開球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope they score early.
dialogue.zh: 希望他們早點破門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at that fast pass!
dialogue.zh: 看那記快速的傳球！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He ran right past one defender.
dialogue.zh: 他直接過掉了一名後衛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that shot went wide.
dialogue.zh: 噢，那一腳射偏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So close, it hit the post!
dialogue.zh: 好近喔，打到門柱了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goal! We scored! Did you see it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊl! wi skɔrd! dɪd ju si ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 進球了！我們得分了！你看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! One nil, we lead!
dialogue.zh: 看到了！一比零，我們領先！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel that? The whole stand shakes.
dialogue.zh: 感覺了嗎？整個看台都在搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strangers are hugging each other.
dialogue.zh: 陌生人都在互相擁抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the victory dance with us!
dialogue.zh: 跟我們一起跳慶祝舞！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only know two moves, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 我只會兩個動作，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Replay! Our goal is on the big screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈpleɪ! ˈaʊər ɡoʊl ɪz ɑn ðə bɪɡ skrin./
dialogue.zh: 重播了！進球跑上大螢幕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What an amazing strike that was.
dialogue.zh: 那一腳射門太精彩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the other team has the ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ði ˈʌðər tim hæz ðə bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 現在換對方控球了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay calm, our defense is solid.
dialogue.zh: 別慌，我們的防守很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tackle looked really hard.
dialogue.zh: 那次鏟球看著很凶喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the referee see the foul?
dialogue.zh: 裁判有看到犯規嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No card, just a free kick.
dialogue.zh: 沒出示紅黃牌，只是自由球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, that tackle was too rough.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，那記鏟球太粗野了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is everyone shouting at the ref?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈʃaʊtɪŋ ʌt ðə rɛf?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼大家對著裁判大叫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our side wants a red card for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər saɪd wɑnts ə rɛd kɑrd fər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我們這邊覺得那動作該紅牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wait, the video review is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ weɪt, ðə ˈvɪdioʊ rɪˈvju ɪz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 噢等等，影音回看開跑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are checking that close call.
dialogue.zh: 他們正在確認那個爭議判決。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No penalty, the game goes on.
dialogue.zh: 不罰十二碼，比賽繼續。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their coach throws his arms up.
dialogue.zh: 他們的教練一舉雙手在抱怨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their striker is running everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 他們的前鋒全場跑動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But our keeper blocks every shot.
dialogue.zh: 但我們的門將全都撲擋下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a save! Did you see that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə seɪv! dɪd ju si ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 好一記撲救！你看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His hands were like magic.
dialogue.zh: 他的雙手像變魔術一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even away fans clap for him now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən əˈweɪ fænz klæp fər hɪm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 就連客隊球迷都替他鼓掌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chant his name, he loves it.
dialogue.zh: 喊他的名字啦，他最愛這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is one nil at the half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌn nɪl ʌt ðə hæf./
dialogue.zh: 上半場結束一比零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not bad, we lead by one.
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶，我們領先一球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halftime means restroom and snack lines.
dialogue.zh: 中場休息就是排隊買東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us stretch our legs first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先起來活動一下腿腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water bottles are sold out here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的瓶裝水賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the fountain by section nine.
dialogue.zh: 去九區旁邊的飲水台裝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That water line moves pretty fast.
dialogue.zh: 裝水那隊動得還挺快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, fill both bottles up.
dialogue.zh: 好提議，把兩個瓶子都裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to call my mom back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tu kɔl maɪ mɑm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我得回一通媽媽的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signal is better out on the concourse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz ˈbɛtər aʊt ɑn ðə ˈkɑnkɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 大廳那邊的手機訊號比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are changing one player now.
dialogue.zh: 他們現在要換一名球員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coach waves number seven in.
dialogue.zh: 教練揮手叫七號進場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the new guy any good?
dialogue.zh: 那個新上場的厲害嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is their fastest winger.
dialogue.zh: 他是他們最快的邊鋒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It turned cold all of a sudden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɜrnd koʊld ɔl əv ə ˈsʌdən./
dialogue.zh: 天氣突然一下就變冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take my spare light jacket.
dialogue.zh: 給，我多帶了一件薄外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my toes are freezing too.
dialogue.zh: 現在連我腳趾都凍麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand warmers are in the small shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd ˈwɔrmərz ɑr ɪn ðə smɔl ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 小賣店裡有暖暖包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, they just read the score.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，廣播又報了一次比分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One nil, home team leading.
dialogue.zh: 一比零，主隊領先。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear those boos from their fans?
dialogue.zh: 聽見客隊球迷在噓了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our fans cheer even louder back.
dialogue.zh: 我們球迷的歡呼更大聲地回敬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second half starts in five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 下半場五分鐘後開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to our seats, let us go.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tu ˈaʊər sits, lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 回座位吧，我們快走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, he scored in one touch!
dialogue.zh: 哇，他觸球一下就破門！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just like that, it is one one.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst laɪk ðæt, ɪt ɪz wʌn wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 轉眼之間，比分變成一比一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That goal came so fast.
dialogue.zh: 那個進球來得太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our defenders fell asleep there.
dialogue.zh: 我們的後衛那瞬間走神了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not blame them, it happens.
dialogue.zh: 別怪他們，難免會失誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more goal and we lose.
dialogue.zh: 再被進一球我們就輸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our coach yells from the sideline.
dialogue.zh: 我們教練在邊線大喊指揮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants the team to press higher up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɑnts ðə tim tu prɛs ˈhaɪər ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 他要球隊往前壓著逼搶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corner kick for us, finally!
dialogue.zh: 終於給了我們一個角球！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big man goes up for the header.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ mæn ɡoʊz ʌp fər ðə ˈhɛdər./
dialogue.zh: 高個子上去準備頭槌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! The header rang off the bar!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ! ðə ˈhɛdər ræŋ ɔf ðə bɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 噢！那顆頭槌敲中了橫梁！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come on, go in for once!
dialogue.zh: 拜託，進一次球啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board goes up, four more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɔrd ɡoʊz ʌp, fɔr mɔr ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 計時牌舉了起來，補時四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four long minutes, my heart is racing.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr lɔŋ ˈmɪnɪts, maɪ hɑrt ɪz ˈreɪsɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘啊，我心跳得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their nine is all alone there!
dialogue.zh: 他們的九號居然沒人盯！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Somebody mark him, please!
dialogue.zh: 快派人去盯死他！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blocked again! Our keeper is a wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɑkt əˈɡɛn! ˈaʊər ˈkipər ɪz ə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 又撲出去了！我們的門將像一堵牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He keeps us in this game.
dialogue.zh: 他幫我們撐住了整場比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every minute the singing grows louder.
dialogue.zh: 一分一分，歌聲越唱越大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our fans still believe in this.
dialogue.zh: 我們的球迷仍然相信會進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A yellow card for wasting time.
dialogue.zh: 拖延時間被出示黃牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They just want to end it.
dialogue.zh: 他們不過是想快點結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much time is left now?
dialogue.zh: 現在還剩下多少時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two of the four added minutes left.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əv ðə fɔr ˈædɪd ˈmɪnɪts lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 補時四分鐘還剩兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone is on their feet again.
dialogue.zh: 所有人都再次站了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our team wins another corner!
dialogue.zh: 我們隊又贏來一個角球！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cross comes flying into the box!
dialogue.zh: 傳中球直接飛進禁區！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shot, save, the rebound is loose!
dialogue.zh: 射門、撲出，彈回來的球沒人拿到！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did he miss that chance?
dialogue.zh: 他怎麼會踢飛那個機會？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The keeper got back up so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkipər ɡɑt bæk ʌp soʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 門將竟然馬上又爬了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One big sigh across the stands.
dialogue.zh: 整個看台同時唉了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it claps again, so loud.
dialogue.zh: 接著又爆出一陣掌聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the score now, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 現在確切的比分是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still one one, deep into stoppage.
dialogue.zh: 仍是一比一，已經踢進補時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My voice is gone from chanting.
dialogue.zh: 我喊歌喊到嗓子都啞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, water helps a lot.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，喝口水舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their fans wave their scarves high.
dialogue.zh: 他們的球迷高舉圍巾揮舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our flags look better, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我還是覺得我們的旗好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last corner, everyone hold your breath.
dialogue.zh: 最後一個角球，大家屏住呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cannot watch, too nervous!
dialogue.zh: 我都不敢看了，太緊張！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In it comes, a head shot!
dialogue.zh: 球傳進來，一顆頭槌攻門！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh my god, off the post!
dialogue.zh: 我的天，球彈出門柱！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Board says two more, six in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔrd sɛz tu mɔr, sɪks ɪn ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 計時牌又加兩分鐘，一共六分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, that is a lifetime.
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，根本一輩子那麼長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last attack, our player shoots!
dialogue.zh: 最後一攻，我們的球員射門！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: GOAL!! We won it at the end!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊl!! wi wʌn ɪt ʌt ði ɛnd!/
dialogue.zh: 進球！！我們讀秒絕殺！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot believe that finish.
dialogue.zh: 我簡直不敢相信那一腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixth extra minute, what timing!
dialogue.zh: 補時第六分鐘，時機太神了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place roars like a jet engine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs rɔrz laɪk ə dʒɛt ˈɛndʒən./
dialogue.zh: 這地方轟得像噴射引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone is jumping and hugging.
dialogue.zh: 所有人又跳又抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our captain scored the winner.
dialogue.zh: 我們的隊長打進了制勝球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have goose bumps still.
dialogue.zh: 我現在還渾身雞皮疙瘩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a game, what a day.
dialogue.zh: 多精彩的一場，多難忘的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best stadium trip ever.
dialogue.zh: 這是史上最棒的一次看球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you film that last goal?
dialogue.zh: 你有拍到最後那個進球嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shaky but clear enough.
dialogue.zh: 有，雖然晃但夠清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send it to our group chat now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt tu ˈaʊər ɡrup tʃæt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在就傳到我們的群組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sending, check your messages.
dialogue.zh: 正在傳，看一下你的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their victory song starts up again.
dialogue.zh: 他們的勝利之歌又唱了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know it, let us sing together.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ɪt, lɛt ʌs sɪŋ təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 我會唱，我們一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Players walk up and down, clapping.
dialogue.zh: 球員走來走去向球迷拍手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is why we come here.
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們來現場的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away fans leave with their heads down.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ fænz liv wɪð ðɛr hɛdz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 客隊球迷低著頭離場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sad for them, tough loss.
dialogue.zh: 也替他們難過，輸得太可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their keeper almost saved it too.
dialogue.zh: 他們的門將差點也撲到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ball just rolled in slowly.
dialogue.zh: 球就那樣慢慢滾進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Final score, two to one.
dialogue.zh: 最終比分，二比一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will remember this forever.
dialogue.zh: 我們會永遠記得這一刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now comes the long walk out.
dialogue.zh: 接下來是漫長的離場路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of us leave at the same time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl əv ʌs liv ʌt ðə seɪm taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 所有人同一時間擠出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elevators wait forever after a match.
dialogue.zh: 賽後電梯永遠要等好久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us use the stairs instead.
dialogue.zh: 我們改走樓梯好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing too long, my legs are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ tu lɔŋ, maɪ lɛɡz ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 站得太久，我的腿都廢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, but what a win.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，但這一勝太值了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess what, the store line is outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛs wʌt, ðə stɔr laɪn ɪz ˈaʊtˌsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你猜怎麼著，商店隊伍排到門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I still want a winner scarf.
dialogue.zh: 我還是想要一條紀念圍巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sold out the special shirts.
dialogue.zh: 限量版球衣已經賣光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the plain ones are left.
dialogue.zh: 只剩下一般款的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take one plain blue.
dialogue.zh: 那我買一件素色藍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, size large fits me.
dialogue.zh: 選得好，大號我穿剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they print the date on it too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ prɪnt ðə deɪt ɑn ɪt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 他們也可以在衣服上印日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they print it while you wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ prɪnt ɪt waɪl ju weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，邊等邊幫你印好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep your ticket as a souvenir.
dialogue.zh: 把門票留下來當紀念吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will frame mine for my room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl freɪm maɪn fər maɪ rum./
dialogue.zh: 我要把那張裱起來掛房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Traffic around here is frozen.
dialogue.zh: 這附近整個堵死了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The subway is our way home.
dialogue.zh: 地鐵才是我們回家的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the station is packed with fans.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðə ˈsteɪʃən ɪz pækt wɪð fænz./
dialogue.zh: 哇，車站裡擠滿了球迷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the trains run every two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə treɪnz rʌn ˈɛvri tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 但班次每兩分鐘就有一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We got lucky with no delay.
dialogue.zh: 我們運氣好，一點沒誤點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, leave earlier please.
dialogue.zh: 下次請務必早點出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet hurt from concrete floors.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳踩水泥踩到痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft shoes for the next match.
dialogue.zh: 下一場要穿軟底的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pizza at six sounds perfect.
dialogue.zh: 六點吃披薩聽起來完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The place near the station stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪs nɪr ðə ˈsteɪʃən steɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 車站那家店會開到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two large pies, extra cheese.
dialogue.zh: 兩個大披薩，起司加量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a big bottle of water.
dialogue.zh: 再加一瓶大水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We look like tired champions.
dialogue.zh: 我們看起來像累壞的冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy tired, that is different.
dialogue.zh: 是幸福的累，那不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the game photos online.
dialogue.zh: 把比賽的照片上傳到網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pick the best ten.
dialogue.zh: 我來挑最好的十張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the sunset shot over the field.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə ˈsʌnˌsɛt ʃɑt ˈoʊvər ðə fild./
dialogue.zh: 加上那張球場落日照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one will get so many likes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn wɪl ɡɛt soʊ ˈmɛni laɪks./
dialogue.zh: 那張一定會很多人按讚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tag our friends in the pictures.
dialogue.zh: 在照片裡標記我們的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I added the goal clip.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ænd aɪ ˈædəd ðə ɡoʊl klɪp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，我也把進球短片傳上去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we write a short review?
dialogue.zh: 要不要寫個短評？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five stars, best day ever.
dialogue.zh: 五星好評，最棒的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is our next home game?
dialogue.zh: 我們下一場主場比賽是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next Sunday, same three pm start.
dialogue.zh: 下週天，一樣下午三點開踢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get the same seats?
dialogue.zh: 我們能訂到同樣的座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app saves our favorite spots.
dialogue.zh: 應用程式存了我們愛坐的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two tickets then, before they sell out.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtɪkɪts ðɛn, bɪˈfɔr ðeɪ sɛl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那先搶兩張票，免得售罄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set an alarm again.
dialogue.zh: 我會再設一次搶票鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This rival team beat us last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈraɪvəl tim bit ʌs læst jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 去年這對手打敗過我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we need luck next time.
dialogue.zh: 所以下次需要一點運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the lucky scarf next Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 下週天把那條幸運圍巾帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It worked today, so of course.
dialogue.zh: 今天很靈，那當然要帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we bring my cousin too.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們也帶我表哥來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves football, he will say yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lʌvz ˈfʊtˌbɔl, hi wɪl seɪ jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 他愛死了足球，一定會答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the cheaper seats?
dialogue.zh: 便宜一點的座位多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty five each in the upper deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv itʃ ɪn ði ˈʌpər dɛk./
dialogue.zh: 上層看台一張二十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upper deck is fine with me.
dialogue.zh: 上層看台我可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can split the subway fare.
dialogue.zh: 地鐵車資我們可以對半分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us eat before we go inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs it bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我們進場前先吃點東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap noodles near the station then.
dialogue.zh: 那就車站附近的便宜麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if it rains next Sunday?
dialogue.zh: 下週天萬一下雨怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We bring jackets, no umbrellas.
dialogue.zh: 外套帶好，雨傘就免了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cup match is two weeks after this.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌp mætʃ ɪz tu wiks ˈæftər ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 盃賽在這之後的兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tickets go on sale Monday morning.
dialogue.zh: 門票週一早上開賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is a harder match.
dialogue.zh: 那一場是更難打的比賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bigger team, and a bigger price.
dialogue.zh: 對手更強，票價也更高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should think about that budget.
dialogue.zh: 我們要考慮一下預算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big game a month is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ ɡeɪm ə mʌnθ ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 一個月看一場大賽剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am already hooked on this.
dialogue.zh: 我已經迷上看現場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, TV is not the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, ˌtiˈvi ɪz nɑt ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，電視感覺不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, invite the whole group.
dialogue.zh: 下次把整群朋友都揪來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seats together, that is fun.
dialogue.zh: 十個人坐一排，那才好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our team lost in the last minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər tim lɔst ɪn ðə læst ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們隊在最後一分鐘輸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way, we won, remember?
dialogue.zh: 才沒有，我們贏了，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so tired, my voice is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm soʊ ˈtaɪərd, maɪ vɔɪs ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 我累壞了，嗓子也喊啞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My feet hurt, my heart is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit hɜrt, maɪ hɑrt ɪz fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 腳很痛，但心很滿足。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time next week, okay?
dialogue.zh: 下週同一時間見面，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, sleep well after this win.
dialogue.zh: 成交，帶著勝利好眠吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night, I will wave my scarf at you.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt, aɪ wɪl weɪv maɪ skɑrf æt ju./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我會揮圍巾跟你招手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night, dream of that last goal.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，夢裡也要記得那顆進球。
